name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted dashboard for sports and fitness data, importing FIT, TCX and GPX files or syncing from Strava, with a background import daemon.

alerts.message: Sign in to the admin panel at /admin as admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment. Import activities by uploading files at /admin/upload. For Strava sync, set IMPORT_MODE=stravaApi and fill STRAVA_CLIENT_ID, STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET and STRAVA_REFRESH_TOKEN from your own Strava API application.
